listing.name: Need for Speed II: Special Edition (NFS Recompiled)
listing.summary: Research listing. Upstream route: Static recompilation with release zip and original-data instructions. Limits: Maintainer explicitly calls it a toy project; Linux runnable route exists with game-specific defects to qualify. Upstream platforms: Linux native C++ release/source route; original executable is Win32 x86 input, not proof of host CPU. Selected Linux package/build CPU unknown; other host platforms only potential. Original data: Supply an original Need for Speed II Special Edition installation plus its CD Fedata/GameData content. Source generation requires nfs2sen.exe and eacsnd.dll in nfs2se/. Exact supported language/patch and binary hashes are not stated in the retained README. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
